verdict.line: You edge the raw numbers at 52.6% over 449 games, but you lose if you brawl into a loaded Deathbringer Stance or eat Infernal Chains on an extended trade, and you win by baiting his cooldowns empty and finishing the fight after.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane that OP.GG marks defensive because Aatrox's kit front-loads its threat: Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash both heal him for free damage he was going to deal anyway, so a straight extended trade favors him even though your winrate says otherwise. Riven's structural answer is her combo density — Q's three strikes, W's stun, E's damage block — which out-trades him once his Q charges and W are actually spent, not before.

theirWindow.when: Deathbringer Stance lit, Q charges up
theirWindow.what: He has a free empowered auto that heals him plus a full 3-swing Darkin Blade combo available. Do not extend a trade here — he wins the exchange on damage and sustain both.

yourWindow.when: He's dumped all 3 Q swings or used E to engage
yourWindow.what: The Darkin Blade (Q) needs all three swings used before it resets on a 14/12/10/8/6s cooldown, and Umbral Dash (E) is his only gap tool on 9/8/7/6/5s. Walk in with Broken Wings (Q) into Ki Burst (W) while he has no dash and no stance up.

start.why: 52.7% win rate over 518 games and 94.9% pick — the AD and sustain matter because you're absorbing chip damage from his Q swings while waiting for cooldown windows, not initiating.

boots.why: 52.9% win rate over 297 games, 59.8% pick — the ability haste shortens your Q/W/E loop so you can re-engage the moment his Umbral Dash or Q swings are spent.

core.why: 65.2% win rate over 46 games as the opener — the cooldown refund rewards you for correctly timing engages around his Q and E cooldowns instead of forcing fights.
Sustained AD and healing keeps you ahead of his Deathbringer Stance poke through the mid-lane trades where he still has a passive advantage.
Damage-over-time conversion directly counters his burst-and-heal pattern, letting you survive the all-in he wants to force at level 6-8.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks through your Q's multiple strikes and rewards staying in extended fights once his cooldowns are down, converting into the healing you need to outlast his Deathbringer Stance sustain.

summoners.why: 97% pick rate at 52.3% win rate — Ignite punishes the exact cooldown windows you're waiting for, since Aatrox has no cleanse for it and his own sustain from Umbral Dash and Deathbringer Stance gets partially burned through.

playing.title: Never trade into loaded Stance
playing.detail: If his Deathbringer Stance icon is lit, disengage or wait — his next auto deals bonus magic damage and heals him off your max health, flipping any close trade in his favor.

playing.title: Respect Infernal Chains range
playing.detail: Infernal Chains reaches 825 range and drags you to the impact point if you don't leave fast. Don't stand still in the pull zone waiting to trade — walk out immediately or eat the damage twice.

playing.title: Punish after his three Q swings
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade can swing three times per activation before going on cooldown (14/12/10/8/6s). Once he's used all three on wave or a poke, that's your window to walk Broken Wings in clean.

playing.title: Block his slam with Valor
playing.detail: Time E (Valor) to absorb the Q swing or the Umbral Dash follow-up hit rather than his auto-attacks — it negates his single biggest damage source per trade.

playing.title: Don't expect an early stun
playing.detail: This skill order maxes Q and E first, ranking W only at levels 3, 14, and 15, so Ki Burst stays weak and on an 11s cooldown for most of the laning phase. Lean on Q's reset damage and E's block instead of fishing for a stun combo.

playing.title: Save your all-in for level 9-11
playing.detail: He gets World Ender at 6 with bonus AD, healing, and move speed plus a minion fear — you have no answer until Blade of the Exile comes online. Play for trades, not kills, from 6 through 8.

playing.title: Itemize into his healing if it snowballs
playing.detail: If Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash sustain start winning him trades outright, buy Executioner's Calling and focus your burst into his cooldown-down windows, matching the OP.GG read on this matchup.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning about cooldown windows, the Deathbringer Stance tell, and the skill-order tradeoff is my own tactical read, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Manage your distance considering the range on Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo. After purchasing Executioner’s Calling, focus on dealing burst damage when Aatrox’s skills are on cooldown.
